title: SQL Server
description:
SQL Server: T-SQL with recursive CTEs, `N'...'` literals from `sql_quote`, and the
session views. Needs `make it-up` (port 11433, sa). See `:help dbdash-databases`.

query.sql:
WITH n AS (SELECT 1 AS i UNION ALL SELECT i + 1 FROM n WHERE i < 12)
SELECT FORMAT(DATEFROMPARTS(YEAR(GETDATE()), i, 1), 'MMM') AS month,
       ABS(CHECKSUM(NEWID())) % 100 + 50 AS sales
FROM n

show.title: Sales per month (recursive CTE)
show.description: Twelve months made by a recursive CTE, a random amount each.

query.sql:
SELECT city, people FROM (VALUES (N'Zürich', 421000), (N'Genève', 203000), (N'Basel', 177000)) AS t(city, people)
WHERE city = {{ args.city | sql_quote }} OR people < 200000

show.title: VALUES and an N'...' literal from sql_quote
show.description:
{% raw %}`{{ args.city | sql_quote }}`{% endraw %} writes `N'Zürich'`: SQL Server needs the N prefix for
text beyond ASCII.

query.sql:
SELECT session_id, login_name, program_name, status
FROM sys.dm_exec_sessions WHERE is_user_process = 1

show.title: Sessions (sys.dm_exec_sessions)
show.description: The user sessions (`sys.dm_exec_sessions`), this one included.
